Specification: This specification models two variables, fun1 and fun2, that are functions from a finite set of node identifiers to sets. The initial state sets both functions to the same mapping, assigning the empty set to every node in Node, and the next-state relation nondeterministically selects one of two node identifiers and updates both functions at that index to the empty set again using EXCEPT. The spec appears to be a small sanity-check example focused on function EXCEPT updates and equality of two function-valued state variables; it defines an invariant-like predicate Sanity asserting that fun1 and fun2 are equal, but it does not include a full temporal specification or fault model.
